messages:
lina: quick note: proposing we compress per-tenant quota keys by moving from route-level quota rows to a hierarchical quota index. current schema has a row per (tenant, route, window) and hot tenants start to OOM the quota aggregator.

ash: so new idea is aggregated windows per (tenant, quota_bucket, window_start)? what's bucket mapping?

lina: bucket = ceil(hash(route_id) / bucket_size) per-tenant. bucket_size configurable per-tenant based on route count. it'll allow us to maintain fixed key cardinality and bound aggregator memory.

omar: how will console show per-route usage then? expand buckets at read time, or keep sampled per-route counters for top routes?

lina: read adapter expands for small queries. for heavy reports we materialize per-route top-K counters asynchronously.

build-bot: migration-plan created: quotas.bucketize.v1 scheduled 2026-06-01T03:00:00Z (owner: lina).

ash: DB migration ops? avoid heavy updates. we should add bucket column and compute at write time and run a fast parallel scanner to fill historic rows with limited batch size.

lina: yep, phase plan: 1) add column, 2) start dualwrite from writer service, 3) background backfill with throttling, 4) create concurrent index on (tenant_id, quota_bucket, window_start), 5) kcutover.

omar: any quota semantics changes? edgecases when route moves buckets (rehash) - need stable hashing function and bucket_size history so we can remap old rows for queries.

lina: bucket config stored in tenant_meta with versioning. queries for historical data read bucket_version to interpret row mapping. we'll keep a migration tool to re-bucket old data for analytics windows beyond X days.

ash: I want a safety flag: if aggregator memory > threshold or quota mismatches >1% for canary tenants, rollback reads.

lina: will add. also adding a reconciliation job that compares per-tenant totals between old and new representations daily for canaries.

omar: good. please ensure retention TTL still applies per-tenant and that compaction jobs can operate on per-bucket sets.

lina: will include TTL migration notes. drafting RFC now, will ping eng-sre and infra.
